title: Stories Through My Lens
description: Capturing genuine moments, natural beauty, and unforgettable stories through photography.
about_text: I'm a photographer working across Australia and Oceania, capturing people, events, travel, wildlife, sport and landscapes. I also collaborate with Japanese television and editorial teams, providing local research, coordination and Japanese-English liaison. My photography credits include ELLE, GQ, Hulu, TVs and athletics editorial publications. Available for photography assignments across Australia and Oceania. Have a project in mind? Feel free to get in touch.
about_second_text: Whether you're looking for professional photography or stunning drone shots, I'm here to bring your vision to life.
contact_text: Have a photography project in mind? Let's create something beautiful together.
service_1_description: Capturing the personality of your beloved pets.
service_2_description: Capturing special moments and unforgettable memories.
service_3_description: Stunning aerial views and natural landscapes.
